0: And then rang out the melancholy peaceful sound of the convent bell, the evening Angelus. Giovanni made the sign of the cross. 'It is late,' said the girl rising; 'I must return homeward. Do you see those torches, there on the road? 'Tis the duke coming to visit Messer Galeotto, who is to show him an interesting experiment with lead. He thinks it can be turned into gold.'
